Are you passionate about cutting-edge technology?

Do you thrive on ensuring products meet the highest standards of performance and reliability?

As a Test & Validation Engineer you will be instrumental in validating advanced imaging systems, from prototype to industrialization, ensuring they meet both customer and regulatory standards. You will also mentor junior engineers and drive continuous improvement in our testing processes.

Key Responsibilities:

• Define and implement validation and verification plans for new products and platforms.
• Develop test protocols, acceptance criteria and traceability matrices.
• Conduct hands-on testing of sensors, cameras, and modules, covering electrical, optical, mechanical and environmental aspects.
• Automate test procedures using LabVIEW, Python or similar tools.
• Analyze test results, identify root causes and propose corrective actions.
• Improve test methodologies, tools and infrastructure to support scalable industrialization.
• Collaborate with R&D, project management, quality and operations teams to support design reviews and product improvements.
• Mentor junior engineers and share best practices within the team.

• Master’s degree in Electronics, Physics, Optics, or related engineering field.
• Min. 5-7 years of experience in test engineering, validation, or reliability engineering in a high-tech environment 
• Hands-on experience with test automation (Python expertise needed).
• Familiarity with optical/electro-optical testing is a strong plus.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to get to root causes.
• Excellent communication skills; capable of writing clear technical documentation and presenting to stakeholders.
• Ability to mentor and guide less experienced engineers.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch is a plus.

Looking for a varied role in the logistics sector?
Would you like to join an international working environment?
Then SD Worx Jobs has the perfect opportunity for you! 

For a growing logistics company in the Willebroek region, SD Worx Jobs is looking for a Warehouse Operator.

Your responsibilitiesµ

No two days are the same! As a key player in the logistics process, you help ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

• Receive incoming goods and place them in the correct warehouse locations.

• Pick and pack online orders for shipment.

• Perform quality checks to ensure high service standards.

• Monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner.

• You speak and understand English.

• Previous experience in logistics is preferred.

For a dynamic international company in Merchtem, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative who combines customer service with commercial flair and a technical interest. You enjoy working in a role where you interact daily with customers, the sales team and internal departments, and where you can make a real impact on business growth and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be the main commercial and customer-oriented point of contact for your region. Working closely with the External Sales Representative, you will build strong customer relationships and help expand the customer portfolio. You will manage a combination of new and existing customers, ensuring that everything runs smoothly and professionally, from quotations to follow-up.

Your responsibilities

• Acquiring new customers and further developing existing customer relationships.
• Growing existing accounts through cross-selling and upselling.
• Preparing and following up on quotations and price calculations.
• Processing orders and encouraging customers to use the E-Shop.
• Maintaining daily customer contact by phone and email, with a focus on commercial growth.
• Keeping customer information up to date in ERP/CRM systems.
• Identifying customer needs and commercial opportunities.
• Acting as the first point of contact for customer questions and support.
• Working closely with the External Sales Representative on reporting and follow-up.

• You have a strong hunter mentality and a clear commercial drive to win new customers.
• You have a commercial and/or technical background.
• You have experience in B2B sales, preferably in a technical environment.
• You are fluent in both spoken and written French and English.
• Knowledge of Arabic is an advantage but not a requirement.
• You are comfortable working with Excel and general IT tools.
• You have strong communication skills and a commercial mindset.

Satellit is seeking an experienced .NET developer with Java know-how to join a multi-disciplinary team delivering digital identity and authentication capabilities for a major energy-sector engagement. The role involves building, validating and documenting reusable authentication/authorization components, contributing to deployment automation, collaborating with IT stakeholders, and participating in agile squad activities. This position follows a hybrid work model with an expectation of being on-site about two days per week and is planned to start in the mid-October to mid-November timeframe. Full-time commitment is required.
Who are you?

Skills & competences:

• Autonomy

• Teamwork

• Presentation skills

• Communication

• Continuous learning

• Technical documentation

• Analytical problem solving

• Resilience

• Versatility and adaptability

• Continuous integration and deployment practices

• Agile methodologies and Scrum

What will you do?

• Design, implement, unit-test and document libraries, services or components that handle user authentication and authorization.

• Create example applications and code samples to illustrate how to integrate identity and access services into new or existing systems, and communicate these to engineering teams.

• Customize and extend commercial or open-source products (for example access managers, authorization engines, API gateways, reverse proxies and directory services) and produce supporting documentation for those extensions.

• Improve and automate continuous integration and continuous delivery workflows, including configuration and release automation.

• Work closely with IT and application teams to identify integration points, diagnose issues, and resolve problems when connecting to identity Fabric services.

• Install and configure third-party and open-source components by following technical guides and producing any required deployment notes.

• Take part in squad sprint activities, including planning, execution and retrospective work.

• Own assigned backlog items, drive tasks to completion and report progress to the squad.

• Prepare for and actively participate in meetings and workshops, tracking actions and follow-ups.

• Propose technical solutions that align with requirements and constraints, present them to stakeholders and refine based on feedback.

• Continuously acquire new technical knowledge, standards and tooling needed to fulfill assigned work.

Technologies (mandatory)

• Hash Function

• cookie

• SAML/OAuth

• Keystore

• MicroServices Architecture

• Bash

• TypeScript

• OAuth 2

• Security

• Symmetric Encryption

• Proxy

• JSON

• cors

• Innovation

• Scrum

• Vue.js

• OpenID

• Azure AKS

• asymmetric encryption

• Java

• LDAP

• Collaboration

• Solution Architect

• Azure MFA

• SSO

• .NET

• C#

• IDP Platform

• PowerShell

• GIT

• agile

• MS Teams

• product backlog management

• SAP IDM

• Continuous Integration

• Kubernetes

• Google OIDC

• SQL Server

• React Native

• advanced rest

• HTTPS

• SQL

• DevOps

• JavaScript

• YAML

• Blazor

• PKI

• Proven experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem in a production environment.

• Practical knowledge of Java and familiarity with interoperation between Java and .NET components.

• Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs and working with JSON and YAML configurations.

• Hands-on skills with front-end technologies such as JavaScript and frameworks like Vue.js or Blazor.

• Understanding of directory services and authentication protocols (LDAP, OAuth2, OpenID Connect).

• Solid grasp of web security fundamentals including HTTPS, cookies, CORS, single sign-on and multifactor concepts.

• Familiarity with cryptographic basics including symmetric and asymmetric key usage, hashing and keystore concepts.

• Experience deploying and operating containerized applications and orchestration platforms such as Kubernetes (experience with managed clusters a plus).

• Comfortable using GIT and participating in DevOps practices for source control and delivery pipelines.

• Database experience, for instance with SQL Server or similar relational databases.

• Nice-to-have: TypeScript, PowerShell, Bash scripting, React, SAML2, PKI experience, and familiarity with identity provider solutions (for example Keycloak, Ping, Okta, ADFS, or cloud identity services).

• Experience designing or operating MicroServices-based systems is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal and soft skills: pragmatic problem-solving, autonomy, adaptability, resilience, clear communication, analytical thinking, and the ability to document and present technical work.

• Language requirements: good command of Dutch and/or French, plus English for technical collaboration.

Are you looking to strengthen your experience in banking operations within an international environment? We are seeking a detail-oriented Operations Associate to support payments, cash management, trade finance, and client service activities while ensuring operational excellence.

Our client is a leading international financial institution supporting corporate clients across global markets.

Description

Process and monitor domestic and international payment transactions.

Manage client and internal stakeholder queries via email and telephone.

Support cash management and banking operations activities.

Comfortable working with deadlines and multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

If you are ambitious, self-motivated, hardworking and a team player and interested in growing your career with an International FMCG business, please read through our job opportunity.

Your responsibilities are

• Improve efficiency of filling lines by developing, managing and introducing a variety of improvement actions with as objective to increase productivity and quality of the output of the filling lines. You make an analysis of production processes and report about waste in quality and efficiency.

Are you looking for a varied job where you can both apply your technical knowledge and carry out practical tasks?

Then be sure to apply for this operator position!

You will be working in a food company specialized in the processing and storage of a wide range of food products.

As an operator, you are responsible for the smooth running of the production process and ensure that your machines continue to operate efficiently.
You do this by:

• Correctly setting machine parameters

• Monitoring quality and making adjustments to the machine when necessary

• Assisting with machine changeovers for new products

• Independently resolving minor technical malfunctions

• Correctly replenishing supplies

• Cleaning the machines

• Consulting with technicians, packaging staff, team leaders, and others

All of this takes place in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C), working in a three-shift system, while strictly adhering to hygiene and safety regulations.

You have relevant work experience and/or a technical background (e.g. through training or education).

You take pride in keeping your machine running smoothly and in resolving minor breakdowns or blockages quickly and efficiently.

You are flexible and willing to work shifts: early/late and night.

Working in a refrigerated environment (approximately 8–10°C) does not deter you.

You are able to work independently, but you also regularly consult with colleagues to ensure a smooth production process.

You do not mind performing physical work.

You have a good command of Dutch and/or English and are able to commute independently to Dendermonde.

Are you passionate about metal, steel, engineering, welding, overhead cranes, or forklifts?

We are currently looking for several profiles to work in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift in Zwevezele.

We are recruiting for the following positions:

• Press brake operators
• Forklift drivers
• Loaders and unloaders
• Overhead crane operators
• Saw machine operators
• General metalworking machine operators

Your profile

• You bring a healthy dose of enthusiasm and motivation.
• You have experience working with machines and a strong interest in technology, or experience operating a forklift.
• You have solid technical insight.
• You have a very good knowledge of Dutch and/or English.
• You are available to work Monday to Friday in a two-shift system or a fixed night shift.
Working hours:

• Morning shift: starts at 5:00 or 6:00 AM, depending on the department.
• Afternoon shift: starts at 1:00 or 2:00 PM.
• Night shift: starts on Monday evening at 9:00 or 10:00 PM. On Fridays, the schedule is adjusted so you start and finish earlier, allowing you to begin the weekend sooner.

Satellit operates a substantial portfolio of mobility assets across multiple European markets and is accelerating its shift toward digital services to improve the customer experience. To support this journey we are hiring a senior Database Administrator to take responsibility for the current database estate, maintain performance, security and availability, and lead the migration from on-premises data centres to a public cloud environment.

Who are you?

Skills & competences:

 
• Conscientiousness
 
• Motivation and positive mindset
 
• Ability to work independently
 
• Quick learning and strong organizational skills
 
• Excellent verbal and written communication
 
• Customer-centric approach
 
• Teamwork
 
• Willingness to ask difficult questions
 
• Professionalism
 
• Transparency and solution orientation

 

Preferred qualifications:

 
• Minimum seven years of hands-on experience administering databases in production environments where availability and reliability are critical, with deep expertise in mainstream commercial relational database systems.
 
• Proven experience designing and operating high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions such as synchronous replication and failover clustering.
 
• Strong proficiency in SQL, including query tuning and execution-plan analysis.
 
• Practical experience deploying and managing database workloads in a public cloud environment, including managed database offerings and cloud-hosted virtual machines.
 
• Experience migrating databases from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms is highly desirable.
 
• Familiarity with open-source relational databases is an advantage.
 
• Ability to automate repetitive tasks using scripting or general-purpose programming languages; experience with infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD for database changes is a plus.
 
• Track record of leading database projects such as major version upgrades, consolidation initiatives or security-hardening efforts.
 
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; relevant cloud database or IT service-management certifications are beneficial.
 
• Fluent written and spoken English, plus fluency in either French or Dutch.

What will you do?

 
• Deploy, configure, upgrade, administer, monitor and maintain the organisation's relational databases both on-site and in the cloud.
 
• Define, enforce and document configuration, security and data-integrity standards for databases and related objects; keep operational procedures and technical documentation current.
 
• Design, implement and operate backup, restore and high-availability arrangements, and coordinate regular disaster-recovery exercises.
 
• Assess, plan and execute migration of database workloads to a public cloud platform using managed database services, managed instances or database servers on cloud virtual machines, collaborating with cloud engineers.
 
• Enforce security best practices including least-privilege access, encryption of data at rest and in transit, auditing and patch management.
 
• Act as a primary responder and escalation point for database incidents and service requests, aiming to minimise downtime and service impact.
 
• Carry out root-cause investigations for database issues and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.
 
• Review and advise on database schemas and design changes with development teams to ensure scalability, maintainability and security.
 
• Continuously monitor performance and resource usage, perform query and index optimisation, and...

As a Logistics Administrative Officer, you will support the cross-dock department, where incoming shipments are received, processed and sorted according to their final destination. You play a crucial role in ensuring smooth administrative processing and accurate shipment follow-up.

 
• Open and manage operational files in internal systems from start to finish.
 
• Prepare and process transport-related documentation, including customs and sea freight documents.
 
• Handle invoicing activities accurately and on time.
 
• Ensure timely data entry and follow-up of shipments throughout the transport process.
 
• Process both incoming and outgoing orders efficiently.
 
• Communicate proactively with customers and provide updates regarding their shipments.

We are looking for a motivated professional who enjoys working in a dynamic logistics environment and has a hands-on approach.

 
• You have completed a degree or training in Logistics. Experience within freight forwarding is an advantage.
 
• You are administratively strong and comfortable working with computer systems and digital tools.
 
• You have a hands-on mentality and are proactive in identifying and solving issues.
 
• You can work independently while also being a strong team player.
 
• You are communicative, stress-resistant, accurate, proactive, autonomous and result-oriented.
 
• Knowledge of logistics documentation and formalities such as CMR, Packing List, T1 and EX-A is a strong asset.
 
• You have an excellent command of English, both written and spoken. Knowledge of Dutch is a plus.
 
• You are available for a temporary assignment through an interim contract and can start quickly.

Our client is a global life sciences organization providing specialized research solutions to pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare companies. The company is recognized for its scientific expertise and commitment to supporting innovation across the drug development process. The client is based in Schaerbeek.

Jobomschrijving

• Prospect and identify new business opportunities using available sales tools and market intelligence.
• Develop and maintain a strong pipeline of potential clients within your assigned territory.
• Work closely with the commercial team to execute business development strategies and support customer acquisition initiatives.
• Manage customer interactions through CRM tools, ensuring accurate follow-up, pipeline management and reporting.
• Serve as the main point of contact for prospects, understanding their needs and proposing suitable solutions.
• Respond to customer enquiries in a professional and timely manner, providing information, quotations and commercial support.
• Build strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to ensure an excellent customer experience.
• Identify opportunities for cross-selling and upselling within existing and prospective accounts.
• Prepare commercial proposals and coordinate with internal teams to deliver tailored solutions when required.
• Deliver presentations and participate in customer meetings to promote the company's products and services.
• Represent the company at selected industry events, conferences and trade shows to expand network opportunities and generate leads.
• Contribute to the growth of the business by developing new accounts and nurturing long-term customer relationships.

• BS degree in biology or life sciences related fields, or equivalent level of experience.
• Proven work experience as a sales support specialist or customer support associate.
• Hands-on experience with ERP and CRM systems and proficiency with MS suite incl. Excel.
• In-depth understanding and track record of best-in-class customer services.
• Excellent communication (verbal and in writing., and proficiency in English language).
• Analytical, motivational and multitasking skills.
• Teamwork and customer relationships development capabilities.
• Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and industry events.
• A second European language is a plus.

We are looking for a logistic officer for warehouse in Vilvoorde. The company is active in the medical field. You will join the kitting team and provide support to clinical supplies operations and administrative activities in all areas of clinical supplies lifecycle of low to moderate complexity studies.

Your tasks:

 

 
• You support logistics and administrative tasks related to clinical supplies and medical devices. 
 
• You ensure smooth processes for ordering, storage, labelling, shipping, and returns. 
 
• You track inventory levels and expiration dates, and prepare monthly reports. 
 
• You ensure all activities follow guidelines and internal procedures. 
 
• You maintain accurate data in electronic systems for the assigned studies. 
 
• You perform routine tasks and prepare the kits for the labs. 
 
• You handle ad-hoc supply purchases when needed. 

 
• You have a good command of English (spoken and written). 
 
• You have at least 2 years of relevant experience in a warehouse environment. 
 
• You are comfortable using computers and electronic equipment. 
 
• You are able to sit for 4–6 hours per day. 
 
• You can lift light objects (up to 7–9 kg). 
 
• You have a solid knowledge of clinical supply processes (e.g. manufacturing, shipping, labeling, auditing). 
 
• You are proficient in Microsoft Office. 
 
• You pay close attention to detail and quality-focused.
